name: Argonne MI250 x1 llama.cpp Qwen/Qwen2-7B FP16 b64 128io
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench, arXiv:2411.00136, All_results.csv). llama.cpp on AMD MI250 x1 (Polaris node; MI250X silicon, filed as MI250), FP16, 128 in / 128 out, batch 64. Throughput = batch*(in+out)/latency = AGGREGATE across batch, NOT per-request decode. Latency 4.29s.
notes: Polaris node, 1x MI250. llama.cpp llama-bench-style throughput; batch-1 value approximates single-request decode.
